r10 can test whether a network trained only to predict B develops a readable, causally used representation of the five sums on the **legal board support**. It cannot establish a unique internal decomposition: a distributed computation can implement the same law without five separately identifiable variables. The verdict must say “A-mediated under the registered alignment” or “unresolved,” never infer an abstract A layer from a probe alone.
